messages:
Asha Patel: Quick pitch — propose a 45-min webinar aimed at engineers + platform owners: 'Practical LLM Inference Benchmarks: tradeoffs between latency, cost, and quality in production'. Want concrete knobs and a short demo. Thoughts?
Tom Nguyen: Sounds great. Audience mix — PLG devs + platform teams? That affects case studies we highlight.
Priya Singh: +1. Make it prescriptive: one slide per lever (batching, kv-cache, quantization, model selection) with measured deltas.
Miguel Torres: I can do a live-to-recorded demo: run a 5k-token simulated workload and show latency + cost before/after batching+quant. Need ~45m of staging time to record a 60–90s clip.
Ruth Lee: Ops note — use dedicated staging cluster in us-west2 to avoid noisy neighbors. I can reserve a GPU node Wed 10–11am.
Tom Nguyen: I can bring a short customer clip from Acero (they saw 2.3x cost drop after prefix caching). Will confirm legal ok to quote.
Priya Singh: For abstracts, suggestion: 1) 'Benchmarks that map to real SLA decisions' 2) 'How to measure cost per output and optimize' 3) 'Quick engineering playbook for production inference' — each ~2–3 lines.
Asha Patel: Love those. Can we draft 2-line abstracts here so I can feed into registration page?
Priya Singh: Abstract A: "Benchmarks that map to SLAs — we show which metrics to measure (p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token) and how to translate them into a deployment policy."
Priya Singh: Abstract B: "Cost vs quality: an experiment-driven approach to choosing batching, quantization, and model size for predictable economics."
Miguel Torres: Abstract C (demo): "Hands-on: run a micro-benchmark, apply batching+quantization, and inspect latency, tail behavior, and cost delta."
Tom Nguyen: Speaker list proposal: Priya (product + benchmarks), Miguel (infra + demo), Tom (customer lens). Asha to host / moderator.
Asha Patel: Agreed. Can each speaker add a 1-line bio? I need them for registration.
Priya Singh: Priya — "Product lead for inference features; focuses on measuring production quality and rollout safety."
Miguel Torres: Miguel — "Senior infra engineer, builds the serving runtime and benchmark tooling at Redwood."
Tom Nguyen: Tom — "Customer solutions, works with top PLG accounts on inference cost optimization."
Ruth Lee: Logistics: proposed date Thu Apr 15 10am PT. Rehearsal Tuesday Apr 13 11am PT (60m). Does that work?
Asha Patel: Works for me. Miguel?
Miguel Torres: Works. I'll need the rehearsal to run the demo from staging.
Tom Nguyen: Works for me but will need a reminder 48h before to finalize customer clip.
Asha Patel: Run-of-show draft (45m total):
- 00:00–05:00 Intro + agenda (Asha)
- 05:00–20:00 Benchmarks & metrics (Priya)
- 20:00–30:00 Demo: micro-benchmark + changes (Miguel, recorded clip + short live peek)
- 30:00–40:00 Customer example & takeaways (Tom)
- 40:00–45:00 Q&A + CTA to docs/quickstart (all)
Priya Singh: Can we keep the demo to 7–8m max. If live shows flakiness, fall back to the recorded clip.
Miguel Torres: Agreed. I'll prepare both: a 90s recorded clip and a scripted 2–3 step live snippet.
Miguel Torres: Live snippet (CLI) I'll demo: 
```
# run small benchmark against staging
redwood-cli benchmark --model redwood-alpha --seq 256 --queries 1000 --output results.json
# compute cost/latency summary
cat results.json | jq .summary
```
Asha Patel: Nice. Action items:
- Priya: finalize abstracts + 1-line bio by EOD Mon (owner: Priya)
- Miguel: record demo clip + upload to GDrive by Wed EOD (owner: Miguel)
- Ruth: reserve staging node Wed 10–11am (owner: Ruth)
- Tom: confirm Acero quote and clip clearance by Wed (owner: Tom)
- Asha: draft registration page copy and share by Tue (owner: Asha)
Deckbot: Template reminder: marketing deck v3 is at https://internal.redwood/docs/marketing-decks/v3 (use slides 2/3 for speaker intro) :spiral_note_pad: 
Tom Nguyen: One more ask — can we include a small post-webinar 1-pager with the benchmark scripts + config? I'll draft it.
Asha Patel: Yes — that'll be our main CTA. Priya, can you own content accuracy?
Priya Singh: Yes, I will review the 1-pager and the scripts.
Ruth Lee: I'll join rehearsal to validate the staging flow.
Asha Patel: Great — locking date and rehearsal. I'll create calendar invites and a rehearsal checklist channel. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Deckbot: Event created in calendar: "LLM Inference Benchmarks" Thu Apr 15 10:00 PT — invites sent.
